personalInfo.name: Bhargavi Govardhanam
personalInfo.title: AI Architect and Full Stack Engineer
personalInfo.summary: Building production-grade LLM and RAG systems with end-to-end frontend, backend, and AI infrastructure for fintech and healthcare enterprises on cloud-scale platforms.

experience.description: Architected and delivered an end-to-end Agentic RAG platform for loan management modernization spanning frontend interfaces and AI infrastructure. Designed a multi-agent orchestration layer using LangChain and LangGraph, enabling autonomous document analysis and deterministic financial data extraction. Engineered a highly scalable system architecture utilizing a React 18 frontend and Python FastAPI microservices backend deployed on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).

Designed and integrated a GenAI-powered RAG chatbot for a healthcare platform, enabling strict natural language queries over resident medical records. Built the core application architecture using React 18 with modern functional components, Hooks, and complex Context API state flows. Implemented intricate multi-step state management systems, tangibly reducing corporate onboarding time by 40% while improving data accuracy.

Led the architecture and development of a high-volume cross-border escrow platform's frontend, executing rigorous KYC security workflows. Spearheaded the foundational migration from Vue 2 to Vue 3, drastically improving rendering performance, system maintainability, and baseline DX. Engineered secure, resilient API integrations bridging the client with Go-based backend services to guarantee production stability on Azure Kubernetes Service.

Architected banking and loan origination UI systems handling sensitive data, implementing strict role-based access controls and resilient multi-step workflows. Built comprehensive secure file upload and validation platforms, optimizing core web vitals through targeted lazy loading and dynamic code splitting. Led a cross-functional team of 6 engineers and successfully established comprehensive Azure deployment best practices for the wider organization.

Engineered high-availability enterprise web applications for Fortune 500 clients (Walmart, JB Hunt, AstraZeneca) capable of handling massive operational scale. Architected HIPAA-compliant healthcare portals and high-performance logistics dashboards using strongly typed state management patterns.

projects.title: PVMA (Predictive Visitor Management)
projects.problem: Facilities needed dynamic forecasting of visitor traffic to prevent operational bottlenecks and persistent under-staffing.
projects.solution: Engineered a precise predictive system utilizing ARIMA and LSTM machine learning pipelines to drive automated decision support. Telemetry data ingestion pipelines feeding into specialized ML models, exposed to clients via low-latency decision support APIs.
projects.impact: Established robust ML data pipelines feeding direct predictive decision support tools, quantitatively optimizing facility staffing and large-scale operations.

projects.title: Agentic RAG Lending Platform
projects.problem: Complex loan origination workflows required heavy manual document analysis and error-prone financial data extraction across thousands of disparate source files.
projects.solution: Designed a robust multi-agent orchestration layer using LangChain and LangGraph to enable autonomous, reliable document analysis and context-aware decision support.
projects.impact: Enabled autonomous end-to-end financial data extraction and deterministic decision support across the entire lending lifecycle.

projects.title: Log Insights Platform
projects.problem: Debugging distributed production environments required engineering teams to sift through hundreds of raw system logs manually, severely impacting MTTR.
projects.solution: Architected an AI-driven data processing pipeline using RAG techniques to synthesize localized logs into actionable observability analytics.
projects.impact: Automated technical analytics and deep system tracing, drastically reducing mean time to resolution (MTTR) for complex production incidents.
